overworked.name: LOW BATTERY GLOW
overworked.quote: 你不是不夠亮，而是肌膚能量需要回補。
overworked.description: 你看起來仍然精神得體，但肌膚底層其實有低電量訊號。長期高輸出令水分、光澤與恢復速度一起下降，最需要的是把能量慢慢補回來。
overworked.quoteEn: You are not losing your glow; your skin energy needs replenishment.
overworked.descriptionEn: You still look polished, but your skin is showing low-energy signals underneath. A high-output lifestyle is slowing hydration, radiance, and recovery, so replenishment matters more than extra stimulation.

stress.name: STRESS REACTIVE SKIN
stress.quote: 你的壓力，正透過泛紅與敏感說話。
stress.description: 你的壓力訊號主要出現在泛紅、敏感與屏障受壓上。這不是單純「皮膚差」，而是肌膚正在對高壓與過度刺激作出反應。
stress.quoteEn: Your pressure is speaking through redness and sensitivity.
stress.descriptionEn: Your stress signals show through redness, sensitivity, and barrier pressure. This is not simply bad skin; it is your skin reacting to overload and overstimulation.

hidden_aging.name: CONTOUR SAVER
hidden_aging.quote: 輪廓的細微變化，是肌膚提醒你開始守護。
hidden_aging.description: 你的膚質狀況大致良好，但你已經開始察覺輪廓、彈性與細紋的微小變化。這不是要焦慮老化，而是提早守住膠原與線條。
hidden_aging.quoteEn: Subtle contour changes are your skin asking for protection.
hidden_aging.descriptionEn: Your skin is generally in good condition, but subtle contour, elasticity, and fine-line changes are becoming noticeable. This is not about fear; it is the right moment to protect collagen and definition early.

recovery.name: RECOVERY RHYTHM
recovery.quote: 讓循環重新開始，就是你目前最好的修復。
recovery.description: 你的肌膚最明顯的訊號是循環與吸收變慢。與其加入更多強效活性成分，不如先讓肌膚重新放鬆、呼吸和恢復節奏。
recovery.quoteEn: Restarting circulation is the repair your skin needs most.
recovery.descriptionEn: Your clearest signal is slow circulation and weaker absorption. Before adding stronger active formulas, your skin needs relaxation, breathing room, and a healthier recovery rhythm.

preventive.name: BARRIER KEEPER
preventive.quote: 你的好狀態，值得被穩定守住。
preventive.description: 你的肌膚狀態相對穩定，重點不是大幅改造，而是維持屏障、抗氧化與長期狀態。你適合以預防式保養把好狀態留住。
preventive.quoteEn: Your good skin state deserves to be kept stable.
preventive.descriptionEn: Your skin is relatively stable, so the goal is not dramatic change. Preventive care should maintain barrier health, antioxidant support, and long-term skin quality.

glow.name: GLOW SEEKER
glow.quote: 你追求的是乾淨透亮、真正接住光的皮膚。
glow.description: 你追求的是乾淨、透亮、細緻而有水光的膚質。你的重點不是遮蓋問題，而是令皮膚本身看起來更清澈、更有光。
glow.quoteEn: You are chasing skin that looks clear, refined, and lit from within.
glow.descriptionEn: You are looking for skin that appears clear, refined, hydrated, and luminous. The goal is not to cover problems, but to make the skin itself look brighter and more transparent.

burnout.name: BURNOUT SKIN
burnout.quote: 你的皮膚正在過熱，需要一場完整重啟。
burnout.description: 你的皮膚像長時間處於高壓過熱狀態，能量被快速消耗，容易出現暗黃、疲態與屏障不穩。最需要的是先重啟節奏，再談進階改善。
burnout.quoteEn: Your skin is overheating and asking for a complete reset.
burnout.descriptionEn: Your skin feels overheated by prolonged pressure. Energy is being depleted quickly, showing as dullness, fatigue, and barrier instability. A full reset should come before advanced correction.

late_night.name: LATE NIGHT SKIN
late_night.quote: 夜晚的欠債，會先出現在眼周與氣色。
late_night.description: 你的作息節奏令夜晚的欠債累積在眼周與氣色上。黑眼圈、浮腫、暗沉與慢代謝，是肌膚提醒你需要重新校準睡眠節奏。
late_night.quoteEn: Late-night debt shows first around the eyes and complexion.
late_night.descriptionEn: Late-night rhythm is showing through the eyes and complexion. Dark circles, puffiness, dullness, and slow metabolism are signals that your skin needs a clearer sleep rhythm reset.
